title: An Application of Python Software in Emission Spectrum Modeling of Yellow Phosphor Material
content: The spectrum modeling of emission spectrum of yellow phosphor YAG:Ce3+ is an important role in investigation the optical properties of white light. We proposed and demonstrated a novel solution for modeling the emission of yellow phosphor YAG:Ce3+ by using the PYTHON software. The emission curve is mathematically described by using the Gaussian function. This mathematical model is simulated by progaming in PYTHON. The similarity between the simulation and experimental results are compared by normalized cross correlation (NCC) algorithm. All NCCs show high values largers than 99.5% which indicates the accuracy and reliability of the model. The proposed model is interesting and meaningful for emission spectrum modeling uisng the PYTHON software programming. Its appliactions offers a blend of cost-efficiency, speed, and comprehensive insight while allowing for extensive control and customization. The combination of these advantages positions this method as a powerful tool in materials science, lighting technology, and display.
